evidence_spans: One of the first demonstrations of enhanced HHG in this platform was the observation of fifth-harmonic generation enhancement in argon driven by an all-dielectric metasurface, with a reported enhancement factor of up to 45 [149].

extra_quotes: We summarise the recent advances on the generation of high-order harmonics in optical metaphotonic structures such as isolated resonators and metasurfaces.
In this review, we summarise the rapidly developing field of metaphotonics for HHG.

Although resonant nanostructures significantly improve harmonic generation efficiencies, the overall conversion efficiency, particularly for higher-order harmonics, remains below that achieved in conventional bulk systems.
Furthermore, the signature plateau-and-cutoff HHG spectra have not yet been observed from nanoresonators or metasurfaces.
